div.div: Dev shares one NAT gateway to save about $32 a month for each extra zone. If that zone has a bad day, dev loses its way out. That is an acceptable risk for a test environment.

text.tspan: Dev shares one NAT gateway to save about $32 a month for each extra zone. If that zone has a bad
day, dev loses its way out. That is an acceptable risk for a test environment.

div.div: Prod pays for one NAT gateway per zone. Each zone has its own way out, so a single zone outage can't cut every zone off from the internet.

text.tspan: Prod pays for one NAT gateway per zone. Each zone has its own way out, so a single zone outage
can't cut every zone off from the internet.
